main.description: Count the requester's private notifications newer than its last updateSeen, under the exclusions and notification preferences listNotifications applies. A notification from a private post the requester may not read, or about a private post that no longer exists, is not counted. Requires auth by a ready community member.

reasons.description: Notification reasons to count (like, repost, reply, quote, mention), applied as listNotifications applies its reasons. All when absent. Served while getMembership lists 'private.unreadReasons'.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
